messages.subject: Re: using Stan's C++ interface
parts:
[moved to stan-dev list, bcc-ing the OP]

I see two use cases for making the C++ interface
more modular:

1. Someone is building a C++ package and wants autodiff
with linear algebra and probability functions.

2. A new developer wants to help out with Stan itself.

I agree with Michael that I don't see much use for someone
using the C++ directly to fit models using our code. But I
could see an extension of (1) where they want to try alternative
MCMC or optimization methods and want to use more of our C++
framework.

- Bob
